title: digitaria scalarum
intro: Digitaria scalarum, commonly known as Finger Millet or African Finger Millet, is a type of plant that belongs to the Poaceae family. This plant has been widely used in traditional medicine due to its numerous health benefits, including its ability to help manage diabetes, reduce inflammation, and improve cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Digitaria scalarum include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-diabetic properties, which can aid in the treatment of various diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
